title: Tech Note: QuickTime Container: Plug-in to display and control movies and audio using QT

historical_commentary.text: This note introduces a plug-in that embeds an Apple QuickTime-based movie/audio player and controller directly into a 4D window, a capability entirely dependent on the QuickTime framework Apple has since fully discontinued (including QuickTime for Windows, retired in 2016). The general idea of embedding native media playback in a 4D application remains valid, but the specific plug-in and its underlying QuickTime API are obsolete and could not be rebuilt as described today.
related_updates: Apple discontinued QuickTime, including QuickTime for Windows, around 2016
4D's plug-in architecture itself was substantially modernized in 4D v11 SQL (Unicode, Universal Binary), making this earlier QuickTime-based plug-in binary incompatible regardless
Modern media playback in 4D applications is typically achieved via HTML5 audio/video in Web areas rather than native QuickTime-based plug-ins
